snippet.title: ARTIUS: Pure Imagination | SAGExpo 2025 ANNOUNCEMENT TEASER
snippet.description:
GET READY. ARTIUS: Pure Imagination is coming to SAGExpo 2025 (Sept 19-26)! 

Wishlist ARTIUS on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3599920/ARTIUS_Pure_Imagination/

ARTIUS: Pure Imagination is a momentum-based indie platformer inspired by Sonic the Hedgehog, Pizza Tower, and Antonblast. Play as distinct artists - Pierre, René, Walter, and Guga - each with their own playstyle, united to fight against Pivolo’s regime and preserve art in Rupestrine.

🔗 More info: https://artius.pvicvg.com/
📺 Full Showcase Trailer: https://youtu.be/HwZd6AHQQDg
📌 Don’t miss ARTIUS at SAGE Expo 2025: https://www.sagexpo.org/

#ARTIUSgame #SAGE2025 #IndieGame
